uutiset.t: Asian Stocks Drop as AI Worries Offset Support Measures
uutiset.s: South Korean and Chinese shares fell, showing investor sentiment toward the AI trade remains fragile even after Asian authorities rolled out support measures and US markets showed signs of stabilizing. Bloomberg's reporters and anchors document the key moments in the trading day. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: 'Risk Is Still Here': How Asia Was Hit By Market Rout
uutiset.s: Asian stocks were hit hard by the fallout from last week’s rout in the AI trade. Policymakers in China, South Korea and Taiwan have introduced support measures, and further action could provide a buffer against extreme market sentiment. Analysts share their views on Bloomberg TV. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Earnings Could Signal When to Buy the AI Dip
uutiset.s: JPMorgan Co-Head Global Fundamental Research James Sullivan says earnings revisions might provide a marker for investors looking to move on AI stocks. Nvidia sank 14% on Friday last week, while Anthropic fell 8.5% on its second day of trading and a gauge of chipmakers sank 11%. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Japan Power Prices Extend Rise to Four-Year High on Cold Outlook
uutiset.s: Japan’s spot electricity price rose to the highest in more than four years, as forecasts for cold and snowy weather in parts of the country make increased consumption of expensive gas more likely.

uutiset.t: Libya’s Oil Output Drops as Pipeline Shutdown Hits Biggest Field
uutiset.s: Libya’s oil production dropped after a group disrupted a pipeline that carries crude from the country’s biggest field, the latest in a number of incidents in recent months that have curbed supply from the OPEC member.

uutiset.t: Asia’s Stock Rescue Efforts Gather Pace
uutiset.s: "Bloomberg: The Asia Trade" brings you everything you need to know to get ahead as the trading day begins in Asia. Bloomberg TV is live from Sydney with Haidi Stroud-Watts and Avril Hong, getting insight and analysis from newsmakers and industry leaders on the biggest stories shaping global markets.

uutiset.t: Timely Fuel Payments Crucial to Boost Pertamina’s Cash, S&P Says
uutiset.s: Timely compensation from the Indonesian government is critical to boost PT Pertamina’s cash flow with the state oil company’s receivables reaching $9.6 billion for the nine months through September, according to S&P Global Ratings.

uutiset.t: South Africa’s Woolworths, Momentum Face Investor Pay Challenges
uutiset.s: Three of South Africa’s best-known companies will face challenges on issues including their pay policies and the independence of some of their directors at annual general meetings over the next week.

uutiset.t: Indian Stocks Briefly Erase 2026 Losses on Record Foreign Buying
uutiset.s: Indian shares advanced on Monday in early trade, briefly wiping out their losses for the year before turning lower, as returning foreign money and the unraveling of the AI trade revived demand for overlooked markets.

uutiset.t: South Korea Says Market Measures Will Ease Investor Jitters
uutiset.s: South Korea reiterated its commitment to stabilize equity markets, but the measures failed to soothe investor sentiment, with the benchmark Kospi slumping another 5% on Monday following last week’s selloff.

uutiset.t: India’s Appeal Grows as Global Tech Selloff Deepens
uutiset.s: India’s appeal as an anti-AI market is growing as the global tech selloff deepens. From stocks to the currency, Indian assets are drawing fresh foreign interest as several tailwinds fall into place. Bloomberg’s Abhishek Vishnoi explains what to watch this week. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: European Gas Surges as Cold Snap Threatens Tight Inventories
uutiset.s: European natural gas prices jumped after temperature forecasts shifted sharply lower, which could put further pressure on inventories already depleted by export disruptions stemming from the US-Iran war.

uutiset.t: India’s Nifty Stands Apart as Global Stocks, Gold Suffer Rare Joint Selloff
uutiset.s: India’s equity benchmark climbed as the S&P 500, MSCI’s Asia gauge and gold each lost more than 5% last week.

uutiset.t: Tata Steel to Acquire 26.4% in APL Apollo Tubes for $1.7 Billion
uutiset.s: Tata Steel Ltd. has agreed to acquire a 26.4% stake in APL Apollo Tubes Ltd. for as much as 155.1 billion rupees ($1.7 billion), deepening its presence in India’s structural steel products market.

uutiset.t: China’s Record State Fund Rescue Masks Deepening Investor Gloom
uutiset.s: China’s state-backed funds poured a record amount of money into the market on Friday in another forceful attempt to stem a deepening selloff.
